To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

The property seizure inventory, property and evidence receipt, search warrant return and receipt, and property/evidence booking log related to items seized at 2961 Georgia St. Apt. 2 Oakland, CA and 3247 Delaware St. Oakland, CA between 1997 and 2008. These seizures were made in connection with the arrests of Antonio R. Burrell. The Burrell family is seeking, among other items from the property seizures, a blue photo album with gold trim containing irreplaceable photographs documenting their history and kinship ties.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Reagan Ross

title: Lake Geneva Wisconsin Tourism Commission meeting recordings

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Wisconsin Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

**Subject: Wisconsin Public Records Request – Tourism Commission Audio Recordings (9/15/2026 and 10/20/2026)**

November 19, 2026

Lacey Reynolds, City Clerk
City of Lake Geneva
626 Geneva Street
Lake Geneva, WI 53147
Via email: [clerk email address]

Dear Ms. Reynolds:

Pursuant to the Wisconsin Public Records Law, Wis. Stat. §§ 19.31–19.39, I request access to and copies of the following records:

1. All audio recordings of the City of Lake Geneva Tourism Commission meeting held on **September 15, 2026**, in their entirety.
2. All audio recordings of the City of Lake Geneva Tourism Commission meeting held on **October 20, 2026**, in their entirety.

**Scope.** This request covers every audio recording of these meetings in the City's possession or control, including recordings made by City staff, commissioners, or any contractor or other third party acting on the City's behalf. If more than one recording exists for either meeting (for example, a primary recording and a backup), please provide each. If a meeting was also video recorded, please include the video file, or at minimum its audio track.

**Format.** I request the recordings as electronic files in their native format (for example, .mp3, .wav, .m4a, or similar), delivered by email, a download link, or another electronic transfer method. Please do not convert or compress the files in a way that degrades audio quality. If the files are too large to email, a cloud download link is fine. I do not need a transcript or a physical copy.

**Closed sessions.** If either meeting included a closed session and the City contends any portion of a recording is exempt from disclosure, please produce all non-exempt portions. Under Wis. Stat. § 19.36(6), when part of a record is disclosable, the authority must provide that part and redact only the exempt portion. For anything withheld, please identify the specific portion and the statutory or common-law basis for withholding it.

**If no recording exists.** If no recording exists for either meeting, or one was deleted or overwritten, please say so in writing, identify which meeting is affected, and state when and under what retention schedule the recording was destroyed.

**Retention.** Please preserve all responsive records until this request is fully resolved, as required by Wis. Stat. § 19.35(5).


**Response.** I request a response as soon as practicable and without delay, as required by Wis. Stat. § 19.35(4)(a). If any part of this request is denied, I request a written statement of the specific reasons for the denial, as required by Wis. Stat. § 19.35(4)(b), including the authority for each withholding. If you need clarification on any part of this request, please contact me rather than delaying production.

Thank you for your prompt attention.

Sincerely,

Gary

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Gary Milliette
